items.item: No Update Records (DML) or Get Records inside a Loop; builds a collection and updates it once, or uses Update Records with related-record criteria
items.evidence: "How to find records: Specify conditions. Object: Contact. Condition: AccountId Equals {!$Record.Id}." and "No Loop. One Update Records with criteria handles every Contact"

items.item: Entry condition only when an address field changes
items.evidence: OR(ISCHANGED({!$Record.BillingStreet}), ISCHANGED({!$Record.BillingCity}), ... BillingCountry) "It fires only when the address changes, not on every Account save."
"The fault connector goes to element 3." (Send Email with {!$Flow.FaultMessage}, its own fault connector)

items.item: Mentions bulk behaviour (200 Accounts saved at once, many Contacts per Account)
items.evidence: "A list edit or data load saves up to 200 Accounts per transaction... 200 Accounts with 60 Contacts each is 12,000 Contact rows, which fails."
